items.promptText: Clean digital cinema image with low noise, fine detail, wide dynamic range and a soft roll-off into the highlights.
35mm film look with fine organic grain, gentle halation around bright highlights, rich dense color and a soft highlight roll-off.
16mm film look with visible coarse grain, softer detail, slightly lifted blacks and muted warm color.
8mm home-movie look with heavy grain, soft focus, faint flicker and gate weave, faded warm color and darkened corners.
Early-2000s standard-definition digital video look with crisp edge sharpening, flat contrast, clipped bright highlights and a slightly cool cast.
Crisp modern rendering, sharp from edge to edge, with high micro-contrast, neutral round bokeh and no flare or distortion.
Anamorphic widescreen rendering with oval bokeh, horizontal streak flares across bright lights and a gentle falloff toward the frame edges.
Vintage anamorphic rendering, softer and lower in contrast, with stretched oval bokeh, warm horizontal flares and smeared, curved frame edges.
Warm vintage rendering with a soft focus roll-off, gentle contrast, creamy amber tones and softly glowing skin.
Glowing vintage rendering where bright highlights bloom into soft halos and veiling flare lifts the shadows into a dreamy haze.
Very shallow depth of field, the subject in crisp focus against a background melted into large, soft bokeh.
Moderate depth of field, the subject sharp and the nearby background readable but gently soft.
Deep focus, with foreground, subject and background all sharp and detailed.
The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the subject, tightening the frame.
The camera pulls back slowly from the subject, widening the frame to reveal the surroundings.
The camera tracks alongside the moving subject at the same pace, keeping them in frame as the background slides past.
The camera pans smoothly sideways from a fixed position, sweeping across the scene.
The camera rises smoothly upward, ending on a high angle that looks down over the scene.
The camera descends smoothly from a high angle down to eye level with the subject.
The camera orbits halfway around the subject in a smooth arc, keeping them centered as the background swings behind them.
The camera is handheld, with subtle natural shake and small reframing drifts that give an urgent, documentary feel.
The camera whips sideways in a fast pan with heavy motion blur, snapping onto the next point of interest.
The camera holds its framing while the focus shifts from the foreground to the background, pulling attention to what was blurred.
Point-of-view shot through the character's own eyes, the camera moving with their head and gaze.
The camera stays completely still on a locked-off frame; only the subject moves.
